content: Firebase Spark (free) plan Firestore quota: ~50,000 reads/day, ~20,000 writes/day, 1 GiB stored, 10 GiB/month egress -- PER PROJECT (shared across all users), resets ~midnight Pacific. No Cloud Functions/Storage on Spark. Must budget per-child writes (heartbeats, usage rollups) tightly or migrate to pay-as-you-go Blaze.
